performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones mean no campaign can be fairly judged yet.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 0 leads across all channels over the full 28-day window despite $106.10 spent and 211 Meta clicks — conversion path is broken.
5 July-31 SOW milestones overdue by 42 days: stack test, CRM migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages/tracking — none completed per SOW record.
4 Aug–Sep SOW milestones also overdue: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — Phase 1 is 10 days from end with no live execution.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 8–10) after averaging ~3/day in prior weeks — organic visibility drop coincides with paid launch, not caused by it.
GA4 sessions dropped to 13 on Sep 10 vs. a 45-day average of ~110 — single-day anomaly, likely a tracking or data-pipeline issue, not a traffic collapse.

suggestions.text: Pause all Meta spend immediately until landing page and conversion tracking are confirmed live — $106.10 spent, 0 leads returned.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has consumed $106.10 across 28 days with 211 clicks and zero leads recorded — the conversion path is confirmed broken and landing pages/tracking are listed as an overdue July-31 milestone. Pause all Meta spend now to stop the bleed. Success check: resume only after a full end-to-end stack test (lead fires → GHL opp created → appears in reporting) is completed and verified by Nacer. Target re-launch: no later than 2026-09-18 or Phase 1 is at risk of producing no attributable data whatsoever.

suggestions.text: Complete the overdue end-to-end stack test by Sep 14 — 9 milestones are past due and Phase 1 ends Oct 1.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones are overdue, the earliest by 42 days (July 31). Without a completed stack test, no channel result can be trusted and Phase 1 produces no proof for the Phase 2 conversation. Nacer to run the one end-to-end test (channel touch → tracked → GHL/NextGen EHR → report) no later than 2026-09-14. Success check: lead appears in GHL pipeline with source attribution intact. If not cleared by Sep 14, escalate to Mateus and flag Phase 1 timeline to his father before any budget commitment continues.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions — 0 for 3 days straight vs. prior ~3/day average; re-check Sep 14 for recovery or further drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Sep 8, 9, and 10 after averaging roughly 3 per day in prior weeks — a 3-day confirmed signal, not noise. This may indicate a listing issue, suspension risk, or category change. No action yet as GBP triage is an overdue milestone (July 31) and the root cause is unknown. Re-check on 2026-09-14: if actions remain at 0, escalate to a fix (profile audit) immediately given the 10 calls and 48 directions GBP drove in the prior 28-day window.
